items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I played like Al Casey and those guys.

ctx.x: [inaudible]. He has to be Francois, you know what I mean? And I had to be American. I play… I didn’t play French. I played like Al Casey and those guys. Then Charlie Christian. And [inaudible]? And that was in the days where the magazines—Esquire. They had [inaudible] the tolls. No, what do you call it?
